query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Maintain and reconcile CRM, portal, billing, and project documentation across Google Docs, Google Sheets, Zoho CRM, Google Drive, and QuickBooks while verifying live system fields and updating records.

requirement_groups.purpose: execute queries or actions against Zoho CRM

query_ground_truth.rationale: Reconciling CRM records requires interacting with the Zoho system directly through API proxy execution.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if access is unverified)] [Prerequisite]: Validate API access using ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_USERS (expect non-empty users; retry after re-auth if it fails).
[Optional (if module api_name is uncertain/customized)] [Prerequisite]: Identify target modules using ZOHO_LIST_MODULES (filter api_supported=true and confirm exact api_name).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm field API names, required/searchable flags, picklists, and lookup/owner types using ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS (use api_name, not UI labels).
[Optional (if filtering/assigning by owner)] [Prerequisite]: Map human owner identifiers to stable user IDs using ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_USERS (use IDs in criteria/updates).
[Required] [Step]: Find target records using ZOHO_SEARCH_ZOHO_RECORDS (criteria only on searchable fields; paginate until response.data.info.more_records=false).
[Optional (for write operations only)] [Step]: Create records using ZOHO_CREATE_ZOHO_RECORD (validate required fields/picklists via ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS first).
[Optional (if modifying stage/status/priority/owner/other fields)] [Step]: Update records using ZOHO_UPDATE_ZOHO_RECORD (send only intended fields; use valid picklist values and user IDs).
[Optional (if fetching related objects)] [Next Step]: Discover related_list_api_name using ZOHO_GET_RELATED_LISTS, then pull related items using ZOHO_GET_RELATED_RECORDS.

[Fallback (if ZOHO_SEARCH_ZOHO_RECORDS fails/returns empty due to criteria limits)] [Fallback]: Browse via ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_RECORDS (request only needed fields; paginate consistently with either page/per_page or info.next_page_token), then filter client-side and update via ZOHO_UPDATE_ZOHO_RECORD.
known_pitfalls: [ZOHO_LIST_MODULES] Modules may be visible but have api_supported=false; using them can cause downstream failures.
[ZOHO_LIST_MODULES] Can fail when the connection is inactive/expired; re-auth and retry the same call.
[ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS] Payloads can be large; fields live under response.data.fields and picklists require reading pick_list_values.
[ZOHO_SEARCH_ZOHO_RECORDS] 400 "Invalid query" if criteria uses a non-searchable field; adjust to searchable fields only.
[ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_RECORDS] Don’t mix page with info.next_page_token mid-stream; can trigger TOKEN_BOUND_DATA_MISMATCH.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Filter candidate modules from a ZOHO_LIST_MODULES response by label text and api_supported
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
p=json.load(open(PATH))
mods=p['results'][0]['response']['data']['modules']
out=[m for m in mods if m.get('api_supported') and any(k in ((m.get('actual_singular_label','')+m.get('actual_plural_label','')+m.get('module_name','')).lower()) for k in ['kw1','kw2'])]
[(m.get('api_name'),m.get('actual_singular_label'),m.get('api_supported')) for m in out]
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract lookup/relationship-style fields from a ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS response
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
p=json.load(open(PATH))
fs=p['results'][0]['response']['data']['fields']
rs=[f for f in fs if f.get('lookup') or str(f.get('data_type','')).lower() in ['lookup','multiselectlookup','ownerlookup']]
[(f.get('api_name'),f.get('field_label'),f.get('data_type')) for f in rs]
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zoho is a suite of cloud applications including CRM, email marketing, and collaboration tools, enabling businesses to automate and scale operations
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zoho. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zoho") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zoho tools.

ZOHO_LIST_MODULES.description: Lists all available Zoho CRM modules (standard + custom) to reliably select module API names/IDs for operations. Use this tool before calling other module-specific operations to ensure correct module_api_name selection and avoid INVALID_MODULE errors. Particularly useful for discovering custom modules and their exact API names.

ZOHO_GET_MODULE_FIELDS.description: Retrieves field metadata for a Zoho CRM module including API names, data types, permissions, and configuration details. Use this tool to discover correct field names and types before creating or updating records, avoiding INVALID_DATA errors. Returns information about standard fields, custom fields, lookup fields, picklist options, and field-level permissions.

type.description: Filter fields by usage type. Values: 'all' (both used and unused fields) or 'unused' (unused fields only). If not specified, returns all used fields.

include.description: Include additional permission details in the response. Use 'allowed_permissions_to_update' to get default field permissions (read-only, read-write, hidden).

field_unique_id.description: The unique ID of a specific field to retrieve. When provided, only that single field's metadata is returned. If not specified, all fields for the module are returned.

module_api_name.description: The API name of the module to retrieve field metadata for. Examples: 'Leads', 'Contacts', 'Accounts', 'Deals', 'Tasks', 'Cases', 'Events', 'Calls', etc. For custom modules, use the exact API name as configured in Zoho CRM.

ZOHO_SEARCH_ZOHO_RECORDS.description: Search for records within a Zoho CRM module using server-side queries. Use when you need to find specific records by criteria, email, phone, or keyword instead of listing all records. This avoids pagination limits and performs efficient server-side filtering.

page.description: Page number to retrieve (default: 1). Maximum 2,000 records are accessible via search API. Maximum page number is floor(2000/per_page).

word.description: Global search keyword across multiple fields in the module. Cannot be used together with criteria, email, or phone parameters.

email.description: Search for this email address across all email fields in the module. Cannot be used together with criteria, phone, or word parameters.

phone.description: Search for this phone number across all phone fields in the module. Cannot be used together with criteria, email, or word parameters.

fields.description: Comma-separated API names of fields to return in the response. If not specified, all fields are returned. Example: 'First_Name,Last_Name,Email,Phone'.

criteria.description: Advanced search using field conditions. Single condition format: (Field_API_Name:operator:value). Multiple conditions format: ((Field1:operator:value)and/or(Field2:operator:value)). Supported operators: equals, starts_with, in, not_equal, greater_equal, greater_than, less_equal, less_than, between. CRITICAL: 'contains' operator is NOT supported by Zoho API and will cause INVALID_QUERY errors. For substring matching on text fields, use 'equals' (performs substring search, e.g., 'equals:Smith' matches 'John Smith'). For prefix matching, use 'starts_with'. For exact matching on picklists, use 'equals'. For full-text search across multiple fields, use the 'word' parameter instead of criteria. Max 10 criteria. Example: ((Last_Name:equals:Smith)and(Email:starts_with:john)). Field names must be valid API names for the module. For datetime fields (e.g., Created_Time, Modified_Time), values MUST include timezone offset in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+HH:mm. Example: (Created_Time:greater_than:2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00).

per_page.description: Number of records per page. Default and maximum is 200.

module_api_name.description: The API name of the module to search in. Standard modules use PascalCase (e.g., 'Leads', 'Contacts', 'Accounts', 'Deals'). Custom modules must use their exact API name as configured in Zoho CRM.

ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_USERS.description: Tool to retrieve users from Zoho CRM. Use when you need to fetch user information such as IDs, names, emails, roles, or status for setting Owner fields or performing user-related operations in CRM workflows.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to retrieve specific users. Maximum of 100 user IDs can be specified at once.

page.description: Page number to retrieve for paginated results. Default is 1.

type.description: The type of users to retrieve. Supported values: 'AllUsers' (all users including inactive), 'ActiveUsers' (only active users), 'DeactiveUsers' (only deactivated users), 'ConfirmedUsers' (users who have confirmed their account), 'NotConfirmedUsers' (users who have not confirmed their account), 'DeletedUsers' (deleted users), 'ActiveConfirmedUsers' (active and confirmed users), 'AdminUsers' (users with admin privileges), 'ActiveConfirmedAdmins' (active confirmed admin users), 'CurrentUser' (the currently authenticated user). If not specified, returns all active confirmed users.

per_page.description: Number of users to retrieve per page. Maximum is 200. Default is 200.

if_modified_since.description: Retrieve users modified after this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:00:00+00:00'). This will be sent as the 'If-Modified-Since' header to the API.
